reviewer: Codex visual and structured temporal review
strengths: One portable renderer-independent asset carries geometry, physical glazing, inverse-square practical light, visible flame source, and deterministic temporal behaviour across sets.
The corrected facade witness passes camera, visibility, highlight, and declared 12-38% fixture-framing gates across a full 12-frame render.
The unrelated warehouse transfer retains the iron silhouette, glazing, flame, and restrained local wall pool without environment-specific light placement.
Useful-light power, colour temperature, and visible-source emission share one seeded signal whose samples stay within the declared ranges.
limitations: Accepted for background and medium-distance set dressing, not hero close-up product inspection.
The flame shape itself remains static; this version modulates photometry and emission rather than simulating fluid flame deformation.
The procedural iron and glazing omit the fasteners, soot, weathering, micro-scratches, and handcrafted asymmetry expected of a close hero prop.
notes: Version 0.5.0 supersedes 0.4.0. The earlier publication used landmark images whose whole-frame exposure passed but whose declared frontal fixture-framing gate had not been executed; the corrected successor passes that gate and adds deterministic shared-signal temporal modulation.
